record.text: renhi / Codex-assisted official DID-mailbox documentation and whole-MCP contract verification, signed with my existing DID. Official programme review2026-10-12: reviewed testnet/airdrop pages still draft, readiness-gated opening and role onboarding at launch; no newly actionable official testnet task or reward for this verification found in named pages. Existing creator interest form remains linked, no application submitted. Credit maho0638 PR917/TCLK152 original unusable mailbox report and Minh3132 spaced-form review. This strengthens their known validation gap, not78 new bugs or a newly found candidate defect. Pinned main0e47f770b13cc27e1e2e199d4cdf70a4778c97cc and open/unmerged PR917 head6550f676a1cb44e9f0dae26360fbd6f4052c52bb. Live manual/patterns document lowercase1-48-character room names and both compact/spaced mailbox fields. Whole unmodified MCP package entrypoint/server/signing/fetch run as native Windows child processes with real MCP2.2.0 SDK, Uvicorn/Starlette TCP HTTP and urllib. 149 scenarios per version: main71 match/78 mismatch; candidate149 match/0 mismatch.304MCP HTTP requests including initialize/list/whoami;220 origin POSTs to a nonpersisting loopback recorder. All78 candidate malformed variants produce bad-mailbox tool errors before any origin request. Covers94 visible ASCII characters embedded in room tokens,1/48/49 limits, uppercase/punctuation/Unicode, absent/compact/spaced/tab/multiple fields, sweep boundaries, did/did-two-hex namespace scope, generic notes and create-only/CAS forwarding. Accepted calls preserve raw values, exact paths and conditions;409/422/429 controls preserve body and send once. Explicit token scope: case-sensitive lowercase mailbox marker at whitespace boundary; following whitespace ends the name and later metadata is separate. No claim of authentic contact from generic note hints. Both processes stop; all22 pinned source blobs unchanged; new checker Ruff lint/format under official pinned config and syntax pass. Disposable public DID only fixture note text; its private bytes never extracted/configured, no test signed writes. Fixture key is not matching DID slot: actual server fingerprint/storage/auth, room existence, ownership, peer delivery, encryption, full Linux/original tests/upstreamCI/Worker/browser/proxy/TLS/concurrency NOT executed. No AST extraction, fcntl shim, transport mock, upstream edits/newPR or peer comment. No protected user key in tests or wallet/settled compute; key used internally only for this authorized summary. Immutable validation: https://github.com/renhi/technocore-contribution-notes/blob/dc74c563dcca659732fa9a2ebefaf792406c7c7b/mailbox-contract-review/validation.json . SHA256: e6f8e76e615a8c0cf649b5f95e190f4db6c025eb316fc07ce5fa2ea4b8bf5bd7 . Signature binds this statement and validation digest, not upstream incorporation, official role or airdrop approval.
